summary: Phase 11 offline retest (iter 14). The one outstanding bug from iter13 (never-opened job offline showed 'FAILED TO LOAD JOB DATA' instead of 'NOT AVAILABLE OFFLINE. OPEN THIS JOB ONCE WHILE CONNECTED.') is FIXED. Verified end-to-end at 390x844 web preview: (1) installer login + open job A online caches it; (2) context.set_offline(True) + SPA-nav back to job A renders fully (nc-list visible, no error block); (3) SPA-nav offline to never-opened job id (24-zeros) now shows the exact required copy 'NOT AVAILABLE OFFLINE. OPEN THIS JOB ONCE WHILE CONNECTED.' with a RETRY button within ~2.5s (screenshot /tmp/jobB_offline.jpg); (4) back online: dashboard loads 12 jobs, cached job A still cleanly renders. Staff regression (employee login) also green: dashboard (17 projects, 85 unassigned), direct /review and /tracker load without errors, project detail renders progress-text, and an unknown project id (24 zeros) shows 'PROJECT NOT FOUND' in ~3.9s (no 404 retry). /app/tests/frontend_p11_offline.py re-run: sync bar text is correct ('1 PENDING UPLOAD · OFFLINE, WILL SEND WHEN CONNECTED'), queued-status is 'PENDING UPLOAD'. Known web-only limitations in that script (page.reload / page.goto while offline fail with ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED because Metro bundle is loaded from network; sync-now click hit a visibility issue; logout tab click hit a visibility issue) are the same as iter13 and are not regressions — the primary flows were re-verified via direct SPA pushState tests.
action_items: No functional action items; the previously flagged offline never-opened error-message bug is resolved. Fix (moving default options into _layout.tsx and checking fetchStatus === 'paused' in both app/job/[id].tsx:25 and app/project/[id].tsx:100) is working as designed.

(Optional, test-script hardening only) /app/tests/frontend_p11_offline.py uses page.reload() and page.goto() while offline, which cannot work on Expo web preview since the Metro JS bundle is network-served. Consider switching those steps to SPA pushState + popstate (see this iteration's inline script) so the test file passes without manual verification. Also, the sync-now click and the Account tab click currently use ElementHandle.click without scrolling; prefer page.click('[data-testid="sync-now-button"]', force=True) and page.click('[data-testid="tab-account"]', force=True).
Device-only (NOT testable on web preview): native camera + GPS stamping, airplane-mode queueing, backgrounding/foreground AppState rescue, Picture-in-Picture video, iOS/Android gallery EXIF parsing.

Both app/job/[id].tsx:25 and app/project/[id].tsx:100 now short-circuit on q.fetchStatus === 'paused' to show the correct 'Not available offline…' copy; otherwise fall through to the real error message. Clean, symmetric handling for installer and staff.
No change to offlineCache.ts user-scoped key format (oc:{uid}:…); isolation across installer accounts remains intact. Not re-tested in this iteration since no code touched this path.

rca_of_issue: Fix (verified working): In /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx the default options are now applied directly on the shared queryClient instance (which /app/frontend/src/query-client.ts exports as a bare QueryClient so defaults must live in the layout) with networkMode:'offlineFirst' and a retry predicate `(n, e) => !e?.offline && !(e?.status >= 400 && e?.status < 500) && n < 1`. In both /app/frontend/app/job/[id].tsx:25 and /app/frontend/app/project/[id].tsx:100 the error branch now reads `message={q.fetchStatus === 'paused' ? 'Not available offline. Open this job once while connected.' : (q.error as Error)?.message || 'Failed to load …'}`. When offline, React Query marks the query as paused (fetchStatus==='paused') because the fetchFn would need the network, so the pause-check correctly surfaces the required copy regardless of whether the sentinel Error survived to q.error. Reproduced the failing case from iter13 (SPA pushState to /job/{24-zeros} while context.set_offline(True)) and now observed the correct message in both JSX HTML and the live screenshot.
